summary.text: Debra Heffernan represents District 6 in the Delaware House of Representatives.

paragraphs.text: She is a former president of the Brandywine School Board and an environmental toxicologist with more than 30 years of experience.
She holds a B.A. in biology from the University of Delaware and an M.S. in environmental toxicology from Duke University, and lives in Edgewood Hills.
